# Chapter 25: A Sick Child

*From BookSource.txt, Page 76*

There's nothing that terrifies a parent more than a sick child. I learned this firsthand when my daughter was three years old.

It started as a fever. Just a little one, we thought. Kids get fevers.

But this one didn't go away. And then she started vomiting. And then she couldn't keep anything down.

---
